intro.title: Numbers, Math, Date & Intl
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple financial calculator that performs operations like currency conversion and calculates loan interest. You will learn to work with JavaScript's built-in Number and Math objects to handle numeric data and calculations. You'll also use the Date and Intl objects to format dates and currencies for international users. By the end, you'll understand how to manipulate numbers, perform mathematical operations, and display localized data in your applications.
intro.usecase: Numbers, Math, Date, and Intl are essential for building dynamic, data-driven applications. In e-commerce dashboards, they calculate sales totals, apply discounts, and format currency for international customers. Calendar apps use Date and Intl to display localized dates and times, while analytics tools rely on Math for statistical calculations and data visualization. These APIs power everything from form validations that check numeric ranges to financial applications that format numbers according to regional standards.
